params.name: aTable
params.description: Table to check for a locked record; the default table is used if omitted.

params.name: process
params.description: Reference number of the process that locked the record; 0 if the record isn't locked, -1 if the record was deleted, -2 if locked by a $lock REST request.

params.name: 4Duser
params.description: 4D user name (or user alias) of the locker; empty string if not locked, deleted, or locked via REST.

params.name: sessionUser
params.description: Name of the user who opened the work session that locked the record; empty string if not locked, deleted, or locked via REST.

params.name: processName
params.description: Name of the locking process; empty string if not locked or deleted; the locker's IP address if locked via a $lock REST request.

overloads.semanticRole: Fills in information (locking process, 4D user, session user, process name) about the user/process that currently has the record of aTable locked.
